title: Sleepy mouse
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='17' fill='#c88a5a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='11' fill='#f2b6a0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='17' fill='#c88a5a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='11' fill='#f2b6a0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#e0a06a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#f7cba8'/>
  <!-- sleepy eyes: closed arcs -->
  <path d='M32 55 Q38 62 44 55' stroke='#5b2f1a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 55 Q62 62 68 55' stroke='#5b2f1a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='4' ry='3.2' fill='#ff7fa8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 72 Q50 77 56 72' stroke='#a35c33' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M34 66 L14 62' stroke='#7a4a2c' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 70 L15 72' stroke='#7a4a2c' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 66 L86 62' stroke='#7a4a2c' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 70 L85 72' stroke='#7a4a2c' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sleepy blush -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#ff9db5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#ff9db5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M74 30 L82 30 L74 38 L82 38' stroke='#9fd0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M60 22 L65 22 L60 27 L65 27' stroke='#9fd0ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
